description: A complete local Sudoku game with three difficulty routes, pencil candidates, correction and erase controls, conflict feedback, hints, pause, restart, refresh recovery, and an off-chain practice leaderboard.
description_zh: 完整的本地数独游戏，包含三档难度、候选笔记、改数与擦除、冲突反馈、提示、暂停、重开、刷新恢复和离线练习榜。
name: Sudoku Arena

aa.description: Wallet access is not required for the active local game mode.

oracle.description: The matching testnet contract references the canonical Morpheus Oracle, but the active local release makes no oracle request and paid entry is disabled.

tee.description: The active local game generates and verifies unique puzzles in-browser without a TEE call; the paid TEE settlement path is not published.

platform.description: Migrated to platform-game engine (shared mode). Legacy contract {'neo-n3-testnet': '0xd4ba00fb7297d08d563d8c281541dbb22725dad1'} deprecated.
